title: Timestamps and TTL
hints: A field now needs more than a value: store a small record per field, e.g. `@dataclass class Entry: value: str; expires_at: int | None = None`, where None means "never expires".
Precompute `expires_at = timestamp + ttl` at write time. Then liveness is one comparison: `expires_at is None or timestamp < expires_at`. Put it on the dataclass as `alive(timestamp)`.
Make the timed reads the real implementation and build them on one helper that returns the live fields of a record at a time. `scan_by_prefix_at`, `scan_at`, and `get_at` all fall out of it.
You don't need to physically remove expired fields — just skip them on read. An overwrite replaces the whole Entry, which resets the expiry for free.
